notes:
Quick summary: Mid-market SaaS (developer tooling) evaluating Redwood for migration off current LLM vendor (primary integration today: OpenAI-compatible API). Looking at Hosted API to validate prompt parity and quality, then migrate heavier traffic to Dedicated for predictable cost and isolation. 

Key quotes from discovery: "We need output parity for our summarization and code-assist flows — even small regressions break downstream tooling." — Head of ML. 

POC findings (hosted): short 2-week POC ran against production prompt sets (support + doc search + code completions). Observations: 1) ~20% cost savings estimated after switching to Redwood-hosted quantized model variants; 2) median latency +10% for long-context summarization (seq len > 2k) during peak; 3) two prompts produced hallucination regressions compared to current provider. Team requests: compatibility layer (OpenAI API shim), tokenization checks, and model mapping guidance to reproduce behavior.

Security/compliance notes: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML mandatory for internal admin console, must support EU data residency for EU customers (some traffic can remain on Hosted EU region), audit logs retention 1y. CSM/Legal want a draft DPA with data residency clauses before Dedicated purchase.

Technical asks (from SE workshop): detailed plan for prompt parity testing (eval harness + golden prompt sets), KV-cache behavior notes (to match prefix caching semantics), and a rollback plan (model-variant fallback routing) for canary deploys. Also asked for per-route token cost estimates and latency SLO guarantees for Dedicated.

Commercial: interested in a 12-month Dedicated commit for baseline capacity + burst pool. Price sensitivity medium-high; positive reaction to Optimize recommendations for batching and caching which reduced cost projection in POC.

Sales notes / persona: AE owns procurement (Samira), SE (Daniel) running daily POC contact, Head of ML (internal champion) coordinating evals, Head of Legal (reviewing DPA).

Next steps logged: run 3-week regression suite on Hosted POC artifacts (SE to coordinate), deliver Dedicated pricing SKU + SLOs, finalize DPA with residency language, schedule exec demo w/ CTO to show failover/routing demo.
